selected_private_channel.description: Install Bandit into private consumer repos from a private Git source pinned to an explicit tag. A private npm registry tarball install is compatible but is not provisioned by this chore.
selected_private_channel.reproducibility: Installs are pinned to an explicit version tag/ref so consumers control upgrades.

version_ref_semantics.installed_version: package.json version of the installed Bandit package
version_ref_semantics.current_source_ref: Git tag or ref the consumer installed
version_ref_semantics.comparison: An update is available when the private release manifest latest_version or latest_ref differs from the installed version/ref.

update_source.description: Repo-local or operator-accessible private release manifest read from .bandit/update-channel.json update_source.path. No external service is contacted beyond the configured private source.

update_check.normal_cli_alert: Normal CLI commands emit a concise non-blocking stderr alert only from a fresh cached update_available result and never mask the requested command's stdout, stderr, or exit status.

data_minimization.rule: Update metadata is repo-local, reviewable, and data-minimal.

non_canonical_authority: Update metadata, cached update results, package registries, and consumer install state are advisory only; repo-native .bandit/ state and CLI commands remain authoritative.
